title: Infernal: Blaze of Destruction (lore build)
summary: The Infernal Flame cards share a name but no engine, as the page says. Infernal Flame Emperor, the first of them, was the cover card of Structure Deck: Blaze of Destruction (2005). So this list is that deck, card for card, minus Pot of Greed and Heavy Storm (Forbidden). Its Pyro counterparts from later sets, Infernal Flame Vixen and Infernal Flame Banshee, are in the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: The Emperor's own structure deck, at its original counts: FIRE Pyros (Inferno, Solar Flare Dragon, Molten Zombie, Raging Flame Sprite, Gaia Soul, Fox Fire, Blazing Inpachi), FIRE Beasts (Great Angus, Little Chimera) and UFO Turtle, Ultimate Baseball Kid and Thestalos.
Its Spells and Traps, all generic: Molten Destruction, Backfire, Level Limit - Area B, Dust Tornado and the 2005 staples.
Extra Deck: Infernal Flame Vixen and Infernal Flame Banshee, the Rank 4 Pyro counterparts.

summary.title: How it plays
points: UFO Turtle calls another FIRE monster when it dies in battle, and Molten Destruction pumps every FIRE monster.

Infernal Flame Emperor is a Level 9 that, when Tribute Summoned, banishes up to five FIRE monsters from the GY to destroy that many Spells/Traps. Backfire burns whenever a FIRE monster of yours is destroyed.
Two Level 4 monsters make Infernal Flame Banshee, which searches a Pyro; two Level 4 Pyros make Infernal Flame Vixen.

main: Calls a FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK when destroyed in battle.
Burns when it destroys a monster; summoned by banishing a FIRE monster.
Burns 500 each End Phase; can't be attacked next to another Pyro.
Grows per FIRE monster; sends one to the GY to burn.
The cover card: Tribute Summoned, banishes FIRE monsters to destroy Spells/Traps.
Pumps FIRE monsters and shrinks WATER.
Draws when summoned from the GY.
Attacks directly and grows each time.
Tribute Summon: discards from their hand and burns.
Tributes Pyros for ATK and piercing.
Returns at the End Phase after being destroyed in battle.
Field Spell: FIRE monsters gain ATK.
Destroys and banishes a face-down monster.
Limited: revives a monster for 800 LP.
Shuffles your hand back and redraws.
Draws or discards from their hand when the equipped monster falls.
Burns 1000 if they have more than 3000 LP.
Burns 500 whenever your FIRE monster is destroyed.
extra: Rank 4 Pyro: pumps itself; banishes three GY monsters when destroyed.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
